atoms.sound: Asia is made up of around 50 countries, with a population of roughly four-point eight billion people.

atoms.b: Asia is bordered by the Arctic Ocean in the north, the Pacific Ocean in the east, and the Indian Ocean in the ((++south west)).
Russia is the ((++largest smallest)) country in Asia and is found in the very north of the continent. It is part of both Asia and Europe.
The ((++smallest largest)) country in Asia is The Maldives. It is a small country made up of many islands in the Indian Ocean.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

hint.label: Imaginary lines
hint.text: The Arctic Circle, the Tropic of Cancer and the Equator are imaginary lines circling the Earth. The Arctic Circle marks the Earth’s northernmost region, and the Equator splits the Earth into the Northern Hemisphere and the Southern Hemisphere. The Tropic of Cancer is located just north of the Equator.

atoms.text: Asia is the largest and most populated continent in the world. It is mainly located in the Northern Hemisphere, and its different regions experience vastly different climates.
Northern Russia extends past the Arctic Circle into the polar zone. This region has a polar climate, with very cold winters and permanently frozen ground.
Many parts of East Asia have a temperate climate. These regions have moderate temperatures and regular rainfall throughout the year.
Many parts of West and Central Asia have a dry climate. These regions are hot and dry, with rugged deserts and little rainfall.
Countries in South and South-East Asia tend to have a tropical climate, which is hot and humid, with lots of rainfall and even typhoons!

hint.text: A megacity is a city with a population of 10 million people or more.
hint.label: Megacity

atoms.b: Asia is the world’s most ((++populated isolated)) continent. Around 60% of all people live there — many of them in megacities.

Tokyo, the capital of Japan, is one of the world’s ((++largest smallest)) cities, with around 37 million people across its urban area. Its large population lives in a clean, ((++organised disorganised)) city with modern infrastructure.

Chongqing in China has around 32 million people. The city is built in a mountainous area with limited space, so it has had to stretch ((++vertically horizontally)). This has resulted in roads being built dozens of storeys high, and even ((++trains cars)) passing through the middle of buildings!

In some parts of South Asia, cities are even more ((++crowded empty)). Dhaka, the capital of Bangladesh, has more than 23,000 people per square kilometre, making it one of the world’s ((++most least)) densely populated cities.
atoms.sound: In some parts of South Asia, cities are even more crowded. Dakkah, the capital of Bangladesh, has more than 23,000 people per square kilometre, making it one of the world’s most densely populated cities.
